items.note: The email opens with "Dear Ms. Alvarez."
Apartment 4B appears in both the subject line and the body.
It says the heater "stopped working on October 2."
It says "I called you on October 3 to report it and have not heard back," which covers both the phone report and the lack of response.
It says overnight temperatures are "in the 40s." It leaves out °F, but the meaning is clear.
It asks for the repair to be finished within 48 hours, in both the subject line and the body.
It says "Section 12 of our lease requires the landlord to provide heat."
The tone is polite ("Thank you for your prompt attention") and firm: it sets a clear deadline and asks for confirmation.
There's no threat to withhold rent, and no other threat.
The email is about 95 words, or about 106 counting the subject line. Either way it's under 150.
